rationale: Price is consolidating tightly at $16.44, just above the take-profit target of $16.35, with extremely low-volume 1-minute candles indicating a pause rather than reversal — the short thesis remains intact with price below both VWAP ($16.55) and the 9-EMA ($16.45). The position has positive unrealized P&L and zero adverse excursion, and the invalidation level at $16.68 has not been threatened. However, the near-flat price action and the fact that the high-volume flush to $16.34 may represent seller exhaustion (as noted at entry) tempers confidence that the take-profit will be reached.
